name: code-commandments
title: Code Commandments
description: The architecture linter judges the codebase, and its hooks run inside the journal instead of beside it

php.hint: code-commandments runs on PHP 8.4 or newer

commandments.hint: composer require --dev jessegall/code-commandments in this project

setup.name: Judge the codebase as a check
setup.run: journal check create "The codebase keeps its architecture" --set command="vendor/bin/commandments judge" --set every=0
